Policy.title: Customer alerts for exposed users
Policy.text: Users who paid an account later confirmed as part of a scam ring must be alerted within 24 hours with safety guidance. Alerts must not name other victims.

Policy.title: Cyber-crime complaint filing
Policy.text: For every actioned scam case, prepare a complaint draft for the national cyber-crime portal with the transaction trail, frozen accounts and evidence path. A human analyst submits it.

Policy.title: KYC re-verification of new accounts
Policy.text: Accounts younger than 90 days that receive more than 10 inbound transfers from unrelated senders in 24 hours must be re-verified.

Policy.title: Account freeze threshold (v1)
Policy.text: An account may be frozen when its fraud risk score is 80 or higher and the freeze is approved by an investigations lead.

Policy.title: Account freeze threshold (v2)
Policy.text: Replaces P-07. Accounts with a risk score of 70 or higher that are members of a detected ring may be frozen immediately; scores from 50 to 69 go to human review by an analyst who knows the scam type. Every freeze must store its evidence path.

Policy.title: Evidence retention
Policy.text: Evidence paths, Cypher queries and agent decisions are retained for 7 years.

Document.title: Runbook: handling job-scam reports
Document.text: Job scams usually advertise a link through a phone number on messaging apps. Start from the reported UPI, check which devices the receiving account shares, then follow money towards the collector.

Document.title: Runbook: KYC-update scams
Document.text: KYC scams send SMS links impersonating the bank. Freeze decisions follow the current freeze policy; check P-09 for thresholds.

Decision.reason: Collector of a KYC-update scam ring; risk score 86 above the P-07 threshold of 80.
